provenance_notes: All selected site records are extracted from the frozen ALA snapshot.
Only spatially unambiguous rows assigned to selected main-grid hexagons are retained.
The demo study area is the union of the selected main-grid hexagons.
The demo reruns cleaning, iNEXT/Chao2 filtering, raster reclassification and metric extraction.
Demo model outputs are illustrative and must not be interpreted as publication estimates.
